name: Asian Tofu-Peanut Lettuce Wraps with Carrot, Cucumber, Cilantro & Mint

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
3 medium carrots
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small bunch cilantro
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice limes into a small bowl, stir to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onion and cook, stirring often, until soft and golden, 4-5 minutes.

Crumble the tofu with your fingers into the skillet. Add half the lime mixture (reserving the rest for the sauce), sugar, chili-garlic sauce, and salt to the skillet; stir to combine. Cook, stirring often, until tofu turns golden brown, 10-12 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the tofu is cooking, add soy sauce, sugar, and chili-garlic sauce to the bowl with the reserved lime mixture. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and thinly slice carrots; place in a large bowl.
Trim and small dice cucumbers; add to the bowl with the carrots.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; pick mint leaves off the stems. Discard stems, roughly chop the leaves, and add to the bowl with the veggies. Stir to combine the salad.
Peel and mince garlic. Roughly chop peanuts.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ cups peanuts, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: When the tofu is golden brown, add garlic and peanuts to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Fill each wrap with salad and tofu-peanut mixture; drizzle with sauce and enjoy!
